# noderings_firewall_rulesets (Data Source)

Lists the organization's firewall rulesets, sorted by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Rulesets attached to at least one virtual machine.
data "noderings_firewall_rulesets" "attached" {
  attached = true
}

output "attached_rulesets" {
  value = [for rs in data.noderings_firewall_rulesets.attached.rulesets : rs.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `attached` (Boolean) `true` lists only rulesets attached to at least one virtual machine, `false` only rulesets attached to none. Omit it to list all.

### Read-Only

- `rulesets` (Attributes List) The rulesets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets))

<a id="nestedatt--rulesets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets`

Read-Only:

- `attached_vm_count` (Number) Number of virtual machines the ruleset is attached to.
- `attached_vm_hostnames` (List of String) Hostnames of the attached virtual machines, sorted.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Ruleset ID.
- `name` (String) Name (exact, case-sensitive).
- `rule_count` (Number) Number of rules, ingress and egress together.
